quarterly_data.quarter: MediaTek press release: MediaTek Dimensity CX C10 Max Offers Flagship Performance (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MediaTek introduced the Dimensity CX C10 Max, the inaugural SoC of its new Dimensity Compute Experiences (CX) family and the flagship of that lineup, to enable an upcoming premium, ultra-portable Googlebook device. It is built on TSMC's 3nm process with an All Big Core octa-core CPU, an 11-core GPU and MediaTek's 8th-generation NPU; the MediaTek NPU 890 delivers up to 55 TOPS and is designed to power Gemini Intelligence features. It also integrates the Imagiq 1090 ISP (camera sensors up to 32MP), Wi-Fi 7 up to 7.3Gbps and Bluetooth 6.0. Vince Hu, SVP & GM of MediaTek's Data Center & Computing Business, said bringing these capabilities to Googlebook builds on MediaTek's Android computing position and its long collaboration with Google. No device launch date, volumes or other customers stated.
quarterly_data.figure: TSMC 3nm; NPU 890 up to 55 TOPS; 11-core GPU; Wi-Fi 7 up to 7.3Gbps
